options.name: abort
options.description: Boolean. When true, perform a 'net abort' before the block. This cleans out any uncommitted changes in the buffer. Mutually exclusive with I(atomic).

options.name: atomic
options.description: When true, equivalent to both I(commit) and I(abort) being true. Mutually exclusive with I(commit) and I(atomic).

options.name: commands
options.description: A list of strings containing the net commands to run. Mutually exclusive with I(template).

options.name: commit
options.description: When true, performs a 'net commit' at the end of the block. Mutually exclusive with I(atomic).

options.name: description
options.description: Commit description that will be recorded to the commit log if I(commit) or I(atomic) are true.

options.name: template
options.description: A single, multi-line string with jinja2 formatting. This string will be broken by lines, and each line will be run through net. Mutually exclusive with I(commands).
